notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md, bundled scripts, fixtures and license notices reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; the mandatory stdlib core and the optional pandas layer (numpy==2.2.4, pandas==2.2.3, matching Debian 13 guest packages) are honestly separated, with the optional layer failing closed on cross-engine disagreement; scripts make no network calls. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
notes.zh-Hans: 仅静态内容审核。已按清单核对 SKILL.md、随附脚本、夹具与许可声明：声明能力 execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write 与必需工具 exec.shell 和实际内容一致；强制 stdlib 核心与可选 pandas 层（numpy==2.2.4、pandas==2.2.3，与 Debian 13 来宾包一致）已诚实分离，可选层在跨引擎不一致时闭式失败；脚本无任何网络调用。无自我授权信任、无拉取未列名 Skill、无安装时特权。来宾执行仍为未证实（Main 负责）；此非运行时鉴定或 App 验收。
